question: Who has been appointed the 52nd Chief Justice of India after the retirement of CJI Sanjiv Khanna?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Justice B R Gavai.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Chief Justice Sanjiv Khanna named Justice B R Gavai as his successor, who will become the 52nd Chief Justice of India after government approval.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Justice B R Gavai is currently the senior judge in the Supreme Court.**
 
• **He was elevated to the Supreme Court on May 24, 2019.**
 
• **He will take charge after CJI Khanna retires on May 13, 2025.**
 
• **He will remain in office until November 23, 2025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Justice B R Gavai**__

 __
 
• Hails from Amravati, Maharashtra.
 
• Was a part of key rulings including demonetisation, abrogation of Article 370, and Electoral Bonds judgement.
 
• Advocated for applying the creamy layer principle to SCs/STs for real equality.
 
 
 
• **Justice Sanjay Kishan Kaul**__
 __
 
• Recently retired from the Supreme Court in December 2023.
 
 
 
• **Justice D Y Chandrachud**__
 __
 
• Served as the 50th Chief Justice of India.
 
 
 
• **Justice S Abdul Nazeer**__
 
 
• Known for his role in the Ayodhya verdict, retired in 2023.
